description: Use this when someone wants to find, browse or choose tea, coffee, hot chocolate or other drinks to buy from teas.co.uk, a UK online tea shop. Not for general tea knowledge. query is the customer's own words; leave it out to browse by filters alone. Every filter given applies at once. max_price is per pack in pounds and max_price_per_cup_pence is per cup in pence. Results come best match first unless sort says otherwise. Out of stock products stay hidden unless include_out_of_stock is true. There is no paging: limit caps the list and total says how many matched, so narrow the filters to see others. If nothing matches, time_of_day, strength, format and with_milk are dropped in that order and note says which; kind, caffeine, labels, iced and price limits are never dropped. Prices are live and include VAT. Next: get_product for one product, compare_products to compare, add_to_basket to buy.

caffeine.description: Caffeine: caffeinated, decaf (caffeine taken out), caffeine_free (none to begin with, such as rooibos and most herbal teas) or low_or_none (decaf or caffeine free).

format.description: How it comes: tea_bags, loose_leaf, instant, pods_or_capsules, sachets, ground or whole_beans (coffee), powder, coffee_bags or ready_to_drink.

iced.description: Suits iced tea or cold brew.

include_out_of_stock.description: Also include products that are out of stock (they are left out by default).

max_price_per_cup_pence.description: Highest price per cup in pence.

query.description: What the customer wants in their own words, for example "strong breakfast tea", "Yorkshire Gold" or "something for bedtime". Leave out to browse with filters only.

sort.description: Order of results: best_match (the default), cheapest_per_cup, price_low_to_high, price_high_to_low or strongest.

strength.description: How strong the cup is: light, medium or strong.

time_of_day.description: When it suits best: morning, afternoon, evening or bedtime.

name: find_products

note.description: Present when filters were left out: tell the customer, in your own words.

general.description: True when this is the general guide for the type of tea rather than the pack instructions.

format.description: Tea bags, loose leaf, pods and so on.

id.description: The product id (SKU) every tool accepts.

kind.description: Type of drink, for example Black tea.

pack.description: Pack size, for example 80 bags, 250 g.

price.description: Live price in pounds including VAT.

was_price_text.description: The usual price when the product is on offer.

relaxed.description: Present when no product matched every filter: the filters left out to find these.

total.description: How many products matched before the limit.

title: Search teas.co.uk
